deviations: Generic-struct imports over prelude aliases: the packet spells &Solid<Point3, Curve, Surface>, but truck_modeling's re-exported Solid/Face are zero-argument prelude aliases (truck_topology::prelude! emits `type Solid = Solid<Point3, Curve, Surface>`) that reject generic arguments. cad.rs therefore imports the generic structs directly from truck_topology so the packet's spellings compile verbatim; the types are identical to the aliases.

The fold calls Mapped::mapped(solid, fold) in explicit trait position: truck_topology's inherent Solid::mapped(point_mapping, curve_mapping, surface_mapping) shadows the landed Mapped trait method in method syntax, so riding the trait impl (the packet's D3 intent) requires the explicit call. Everything else of D3 is literally the landed Mapped chain.

D5 collapse-arm choice (left open by the packet): Refusal::Collapsed(Collapse { reason: CollapseReason::KnifeEdge }). Derivation: a collinear point set collapses the planar region to a line — the certified zero-area degeneracy with lfs = 0, which is exactly the knife-edge arm; ApexVanishing is cone-specific (§16.1 apex-vanishing). Fewer than 3 distinct points takes the same arm: the exact predicates certify the same zero-area outcome.

make_face with no material region refuses Refusal::Empty. The packet defines material regions by the session-28 rule; when that rule selects nothing (e.g. a clockwise-only profile whose interior has winding != 1) the operation's domain is empty, and extrude.rs's select_material already establishes Empty as the typed outcome for that state. No new refusal arm invented.

Certificate methods: solid_bounding_box certifies Method::Interval because its per-edge derivations are outward-rounded interval arithmetic; the similarity fold, make_face, and make_hull certify Method::Exact following extrude_profile's house precedent for closed-form certified construction (combinatorial, no sampling, no Newton work). solid_bounding_box returns the caller's untouched ledger as budget_left (D2: taken for API stability, spent NOT AT ALL); the other ops certify Budget::new(0, 0, 0).

D2's cylinder machine-check witness lives inside test 1 rather than an eleventh test: the packet requires the witness 'in test 1's family' while fixing tests_added at 10. Witness content: the extruded bare circle (disk) derives the exact rim-hull box [1,3]x[1,3]x[0,2] and 24x7 sampled interior-wall points (v strictly between the rims) all lie inside it. The rule was NOT falsified.

D3's defensive certificate accepts Derived-Placed carriers as recognized (only Unrecognized refuses), matching the packet's wording. Note the interaction with the landed canonical rule (BG-CE-006-r2): any non-identity linear part places bare analytic carriers, so uniform-scaling or mirroring a solid with Cylinder/Sphere/Cone/Torus faces emits Surface::Processor (Placed) carriers for those faces — recognized and downstream-consumable, gate does not fire. The packet's 'P1 emits and consumes bare canonical carriers only' rule is enforced where D2/D4/D5 apply it: solid_bounding_box refuses Placed face carriers, and make_face/make_hull emit only bare Plane/Line/Circle. The ten tests exercise the flagship box, whose carriers stay bare under all three ops.
